effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` of USDC (0xb88339…, the vault's immutable asset) from their wallet to the vault.
The vault mints gtUSDCc shares to `receiver`. The number is assets × (totalSupply + 10^12) / (totalAssets + 1), rounded down, and it comes from vault storage.
Before the conversion, the vault accrues interest and mints fee shares to the fee recipient. This changes the exchange rate but moves none of the signer's own tokens.
formats.shown: The intent "Deposit", then fields that show the exact USDC amount, the constant ticker gtUSDCc, and the receiver of the shares. The number of shares is not shown.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many gtUSDCc shares the receiver gets, and calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 0: the signer received 2 gtUSDCc (2000000000000000000). The screen shows only 'Share ticker: gtUSDCc'.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the share amount. Rename 'Share ticker' to 'Receive shares (vault token)' so it is clear that this asset arrives.

findings.title: deposit uses the label 'Deposit asset' on an amount, and the intent names no asset or vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit: `"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "tokenAmount"`; `"intent": "Deposit"`; interpolatedIntent is absent.
findings.fix: Set the label to "Deposit amount". Add an interpolatedIntent: "Deposit {assets} into gtUSDCc vault for {receiver}".

cases.notes: The screen shows 2 USDC out exactly. The 2 gtUSDCc that arrive are shown only as a ticker, with no amount. The reader knew shares arrive but did not know how many.

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` gtUSDCc to `receiver`.

The signer pays USDC to the vault. The amount is shares × (totalAssets + 1) / (totalSupply + 10^12), rounded up. It comes from storage, and no maximum in the calldata limits it. Only the signer's USDC allowance to the vault caps it.
Before the conversion, the vault accrues interest and mints fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: The intent "Mint", the constant 'Deposit asset: USDC' with no amount, the exact share amount, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer's wallet, and calldata has no cap on it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. ERC4626._deposit: `safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)`. Case 1: the signer sent 1 unit of USDC (0.000001). The screen shows 'Deposit asset: USDC' with no amount.
findings.fix: ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter, so no field can show it. Rename the field to "You pay (USDC, amount set by vault rate)".

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`, with no interpolatedIntent. The code pulls USDC from the caller in ERC4626._deposit.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Buy vault shares with USDC". Add an interpolatedIntent: "Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paid in USDC".

cases.notes: The signer's only effect is 0.000001 USDC out. The screen names USDC but no amount. The shares went to 0xdead, and the reader read that right.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns gtUSDCc shares from `owner`. The number is assets × (totalSupply + 10^12) / (totalAssets + 1), rounded up, from storage.
When the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `owner` by that number of shares.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: The intent "Withdraw", 'Withdraw exactly' with the USDC amount, the receiver as 'To', and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many gtUSDCc shares it burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares)`. Case 2: the signer lost 0.019977875929760971 gtUSDCc, and no field shows this.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. Add a constant field such as 'Burns shares: gtUSDCc' so the signer sees that their shares leave.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' names no asset or vault, and the label 'Owner' does not say whose shares burn.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent: "Withdraw {assets} from gtUSDCc vault to {receiver}". Rename 'Owner' to 'Burn shares of'.

cases.notes: The reader guessed that shares leave but had no amount. The 0.02 USDC in was read exactly.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` gtUSDCc from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's share allowance.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount is shares × (totalAssets + 1) / (totalSupply + 10^12), rounded down, from storage, and calldata has no minimum.
formats.shown: The intent "Redeem", the shares to redeem in gtUSDCc, the receiver as 'To', and the owner. Nothing names USDC or the amount received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets)`. The descriptor redeem fields are only shares, To and Owner. Case 3: the signer received 852113.838788 USDC, and the screen names no asset. The reader wrote 'USDC is only a guess'.
findings.fix: Add `{"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. Add an interpolatedIntent: "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC arrives, and calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 3: 852113838788 USDC in, and no amount is on the screen.
findings.fix: ERC-4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter, so no field can show it.

cases.notes: The shares burned were shown exactly. The USDC received has no asset name and no amount on the screen.
